# Transporeon: Freight Audit data (FSI) API

- **Product:** Transporeon: Freight Audit data (FSI) API (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** OAuth 2.0 or bearer. Declared security schemes: bearerAuth, oauth2.
- **Access:** Transporeon Freight Audit (ControlPay) customers.
- **To call it you would need:** ControlPay API credentials for api.controlpay.com.
- **Documented servers:** `https://api.controlpay.com/v1/fsi`.
- **Definition:** [transporeon/controlpay-v1-fsi-api-docs](https://api.controlpay.com/v1/fsi/api-docs) (FSI Data API, version 1.0). Documentation: https://transporeon-hcskb.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ADPD/pages/180912132/API+for+Freight+Audit+data.
